items.raw_excerpt: The Edappally-Aroor elevated highway project in Kochi is temporarily on hold as priorities shift to widening NH 66.
items.summary_en: The Edappally-Aroor elevated highway project in Kochi has been put on hold for now. The government will first focus on widening National Highway 66. The highway work is expected to resume later.

items.raw_excerpt: La localidad valenciana de Foios reúne a más de 7.000 personas para homenajear al mundialista
items.summary_en: More than 7,000 people gathered in Foios, a small town in Valencia, to honor Ferran Torres. The footballer came back home after scoring a goal in the World Cup. Torres said it is an honor to have all these people there for him.
items.summary_ko: 발렌시아의 작은 마을 포이오스에 7천 명이 넘는 사람들이 페란 토레스를 기리기 위해 모였다. 축구선수 페란 토레스가 월드컵에서 골을 넣은 뒤 고향으로 돌아왔다. 토레스는 이 많은 사람들이 자신을 위해 모여 준 것이 영광이라고 말했다.
items.title_en: Ferran Torres returns to his hometown after scoring a World Cup goal
items.title_ko: 페란 토레스, 월드컵 골 넣고 고향 마을로 돌아와
items.title_original: Ferran Torres regresa a su pueblo natal tras marcar el gol del Mundial: "Es un honor tener a toda esta gente por mí" - La Razón

items.summary_en: A New Zealand farm family changed their farm from raising sheep and beef to growing olives. The Country Life radio show shared this change. It shows a small farm trying a very different crop.

items.raw_excerpt: Alrededor de 6.602 personas recibirán el beneficio, pertenecientes a familias vulnerables que reciben mensualmente el bono por el programa Control Niño Sano. El monto, de 45 mil pesos, será pagado a través del Instituto de Previsión Social (ISP), cuyo proceso se extenderá hasta el 28 de agosto.
items.summary_en: About 6,602 people will receive a payment of 45,000 pesos. They are vulnerable families who get a monthly benefit through the Healthy Child Program. The payment is made by the Social Security Institute and lasts until August 28.

items.raw_excerpt: On Saturday morning, Aucklanders will have a chance to see inside the City Rail Link (CRL) for the first time.

items.raw_excerpt: Housed in an abandoned lumberyard, South River’s Crystal Cave features Canada’s largest private mineral exhibit, a fairy forest, and geode cracking.

items.summary_en: Cristo Redentor, the Sugarloaf cable car and other Rio de Janeiro tourist spots closed today as a safety measure. Tijuca National Park and museums also shut their doors. Strong winds caused the closures.

items.raw_excerpt: A man who made several trips across the Gordie Howe International Bridge during opening week says he was double charged for some of those trips and is urging other travelers to check their credit card bills.
items.summary_en: A man crossed the Gordie Howe International Bridge several times during its opening week. He says some trips were charged twice. He wants other travelers to check their credit card bills.

items.raw_excerpt: Mexico and Japan launch a joint program using tech and funding to tackle the sargassum crisis hitting Caribbean beaches.
items.summary_en: Mexico and Japan started a joint program to tackle the sargassum problem on Caribbean beaches. The program uses technology and funding. Sargassum is a seaweed that piles up on beaches and hurts tourism.

items.summary_en: Tree pruning work on federal highway 190, between Pueblo Nuevo and the Santa Rosa Zonal Market, is causing heavy traffic. Drivers can expect delays in the area.

items.raw_excerpt: Victorian residents donate money to a man's mission to make crumbling country roads safer as they wait for government action.
items.summary_en: A man in rural Victoria is painting potholes to make them easy to see. Local residents sent him money to support his mission. They want country roads to be safer while they wait for the government to act.

items.raw_excerpt: A aldeia de Casal de São Simão, no concelho de Figueiró dos Vinhos, surge como um dos exemplos mais autênticos…
items.summary_en: A small village called Casal de São Simão is hidden near Figueiró dos Vinhos, about 40 km from Coimbra. It is known for its crystal-clear water and authentic, simple charm. Now the village is drawing more and more visitors.

items.raw_excerpt: The Department of Conservation's (DOC) systems for counting visitors and activities at 700 sites on public conservation land are old and plagued by delays, and data loss and backlogs.
items.summary_en: New Zealand's conservation department counts visitors at 700 sites with old equipment. The counting systems are slow and lose data. This makes it hard to know how many people visit nature areas.

items.raw_excerpt: Tash Anderson has become Australia's top female pinball competitor since being roped into attending a social event three years ago.
items.summary_en: Three years ago Tash Anderson was roped into a social event. Now she is Australia's top female pinball competitor. A new generation is enjoying the retro game as pinball machines ping and buzz again.

items.raw_excerpt: Reuben Oh and Yumika Yamamoto overcame the challenges of brewing sake in Singapore to create distinctly local expressions now served at Michelin-starred restaurants, recognised in international competitions and supported by a growing community.
items.summary_en: Reuben Oh and Yumika Yamamoto started Singapore's only sake brewery in Jurong. They brew sake with local ingredients such as pulut hitam. Their sake is served at Michelin-starred restaurants and has won recognition in Japan.
items.summary_ko: 루벤 오와 유미카 야마모토 부부가 주롱에서 싱가포르 유일의 사케 양조장을 열었다. 그들은 pulut hitam 같은 현지 재료로 싱가포르만의 사케를 빚는다. 이 사케는 미슐랭 스타 레스토랑에서 맛볼 수 있고 일본 대회에서도 인정을 받았다.

items.raw_excerpt: Entre teares, lã e saberes antigos, a pequena Aldeia do Xisto de Aldeia das Dez vai transformar-se num verdadeiro palco…
items.summary_en: A small schist village called Aldeia das Dez is hosting a festival of weaving looms, wool and old crafts. The village will turn into a stage for these traditions. It sits in the Coimbra region of Portugal.

items.raw_excerpt: Entre a tranquilidade da Ribeira da Isna e a paisagem verde do concelho de Proença-a-Nova, a Praia Fluvial da Aldeia…
items.summary_en: A river beach in Proença-a-Nova offers a playground, picnic park, swimming pool, and bungalows right by the water. It is a little more than an hour from Coimbra. People come to enjoy the quiet river and the green countryside.

items.summary_en: A new children's book honours the geological history of North Otago. It shares the region's ancient story in a way kids can enjoy. It is a small, local book project.

items.summary_en: A play about gender violence starts its season in Recife. It runs from Wednesday to August 7 at Caixa Cultural Recife. The play was created by the Gompa group from Rio Grande do Sul.
